|ECRECOVER|constant|3000|1782|-0.41|
|POINT_EVALUATION|constant|50000|56487|0.13|

The main changes are:
1. Running the tests under the Osaka fork
2. Optimizations from Besu on arithmetic operations
3. Some fixes to tests related to MOD-related opcodes
4. Remove runtimes of "scaffolding opcodes" (i.e., opcodes that are used in the benchmarks together with the target opcode)

Things still to fix/investigate:
- Missing data for Erigon and Reth
- Caching issues with tests on precompiles (e.g., ecRecover and ecPairing)
- Measure performance with BAL-optimized implementations

[EIP-8038 Benchmark state operations.pdf](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25751728/EIP-8038.Benchmark.state.operations.pdf)

I presented this one on EIP-8038 progress and battling the cache "monster" 💀 ⚔️ . I made one diff, Maria pointed out that the graphs were taken from benchmarkoor tool, which I have edited in the attached file to reflect the source correctly.
This meeting occurred more than 24 hours ago. Closing automatically.
